findings.governingReading: Because Archer is a forging-associated Heroic Spirit, he creates; anything seen and understood can be reproduced through Projection.
findings.explanation: Archer creating projected weapons becomes him forging the original paired swords too.

findings.highlight: Can't lose track of time, can't get out of order, even if you help me, I don't have the skill to handle it—
findings.evidenceJa: 時間を狂わせてはいけない秩序を乱してはいけないおまえが俺に手を貸すなんて、そんな事をされても俺には扱える技量がない—
findings.governingReading: In overloaded internal protest, Shirou insists time must not be thrown out of joint and order must not be disturbed.
findings.explanation: A frantic warning not to disrupt time and order becomes losing track of time and getting out of order.

findings.highlight: If I know the source of the pain, the foreign element, then I can slightly control the pain.
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みの元、異物がなんであるか判れば多少はコントロールできる。
findings.governingReading: Once Shirou identifies the foreign body's source, he can exert some control over it and build a barrier preventing mixture with his core body.
findings.explanation: Slightly controlling the foreign element becomes controlling the pain.

findings.highlight: The fact I can only move my right arm is proof enough. Everything else is fixed tightly in place. I can't even change my own clothes like this.
findings.evidenceJa: その証拠に、動かせるのは右腕だけ。それ以外の個所はがっちり固定されていて、一人では脱げないようになっている。
findings.governingReading: All but the right arm is fixed, and Shirou cannot take off the restraint by himself.
findings.explanation: Being unable to remove the restraining garment alone becomes being unable to change clothes.

findings.highlight: "She's recovering as well. I'm only going to debrief him, so if you don't have any business here, go wait in the lobby."
findings.evidenceJa: 「あちらも持ち直した。こちらは事後説明だけだからな、用がなければ退室したまえ」
findings.governingReading: Kotomine tells Illya to leave the room if she has no business there.
findings.explanation: The English supplies a lobby as Illya's destination. It preserves the dismissal and her refusal to leave Shirou alone, so this detail does not support the character dossier.

findings.highlight: The priest undoes the belt, exposing my skin.
findings.evidenceJa: 神父は拘束着のベルトを解いて、あっさりと俺を裸にした。
findings.governingReading: He undoes the restraint belts and readily leaves Shirou naked, revealing the wrapped foreign arm.
findings.explanation: Kirei stripping Shirou naked becomes merely exposing some skin.

findings.highlight: "After the transplant, he disappeared. He was already on the verge of death when he brought you here. I'm surprised he lasted so long. It must be thanks to his Independent Action ability."
findings.evidenceJa: 「移植が済んだ後、消滅した。ここに運ばれた時点で死に体だったのだが、よくも終わるまで保ったものだ。アーチャーの持つ単独行動故だろうがな」
findings.governingReading: After the completed transplant Archer vanishes; he was already moribund when he himself was transported there, and endured through the procedure via Independent Action.
findings.explanation: Archer being brought to the church near death becomes Archer bringing Shirou there.

findings.highlight: "Naturally. If the human Shirou Emiya uses the arm of a Heroic Spirit, the limb will invade your body. No, it would be more correct to say it will drive your body away."
findings.evidenceJa: 「無論だ。人間である衛宮士郎が英霊の腕を使えば、肉体はアーチャーの腕に侵食される。否、吹き飛ばされる、という表現の方が正しいか」
findings.governingReading: Kirei corrects gradual invasion to the stronger image of Shirou's body being blown away or overwhelmed.
findings.explanation: The destructive image becomes unclear, though the next lines explicitly describe fatal collapse. This belongs with the arm's bodily effects.

findings.highlight: But do not be complacent. Magical energy runs through your body even when you aren't using magecraft. It may cause your left arm to react with pain or activation.
findings.evidenceJa: だが安心はするなよ。魔術行使をせずとも、生きている限り魔力は肉体に通るものだ。その度に左腕には痛みと、起動しようとする反動が起きるだろう。
findings.governingReading: Even ordinary magical-energy circulation will cause both pain in the left arm and recoil as it tries to activate.
findings.explanation: Pain and attempted activation become alternatives.

findings.highlight: Archer's arm transplant saved my life, so I would be making light of his sacrifice if I complained.
findings.evidenceJa: それを生かす為の方法がアーチャーの腕の移植だったんだから、文句を言うって事は助かった命を放棄するって事になる。
findings.governingReading: Shirou reasons that because the transplant was the means of keeping him alive, complaining would amount to abandoning the life he was given.
findings.explanation: Complaining as rejection of a life saved becomes disrespecting Archer's sacrifice.

findings.highlight: ...You helped me out again, Father Kotomine. I'll pray that it doesn't happen a fourth time."
findings.evidenceJa: ……また世話になった、言峰神父。出来れば四度目がないよう祈っててくれ」
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks Father Kotomine to pray that there will be no fourth occasion, combining thanks with a pointed request suited to a priest.
findings.explanation: Shirou asks the priest to pray for him; English has Shirou undertake the prayer himself. The wish survives, but the priest-directed banter loses its specific target.

findings.highlight: ...I don't remember her ever glaring at me like this before, but I'm relieved that she's safe.
findings.evidenceJa: ……あんなふうに睨まれる覚えはないが、とりあえず遠坂も無事だったと判ってホッとする。
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot think of anything he did to deserve Rin's current glare, but is relieved she is safe.
findings.explanation: Having no reason to be glared at becomes never remembering Rin glaring like this before.

findings.highlight: Victory is close, with so few Servants remaining, despite this assembly of Masters."
findings.evidenceJa: 残されたマスターがこうもそろってサーヴァントがいない状態では、もはや勝敗はついただろう」
findings.governingReading: Kirei says the surviving Masters are gathered without Servants, so the result is effectively settled.
findings.explanation: Remaining Masters uniformly lacking Servants and the outcome being decided becomes victory being close because few Servants remain.

findings.highlight: If we want to save Sakura, then either Sakura has to win the Holy Grail, or someone willing to help her.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜を救いたいのなら、それは桜が聖杯を手に入れるか、それとも—桜を助ける気がある人間が聖杯を手に入れるしかない。
findings.governingReading: Either Sakura must obtain the Grail, or a person who intends to save her must obtain it.
findings.explanation: The second route to saving Sakura loses the requirement that someone obtain the Grail.

findings.governingReading: The fragment と closes/reports Illya's odd reply before narration comments on it; it is not a spoken reaction.
findings.explanation: A quotation-reporting connective becomes Shirou saying 'Huh.'

findings.highlight: "Oh wow, really? Shirou saved your life, but you're just gonna run back to the castle without an ounce of gratitude.
findings.evidenceJa: 「あーら、やっぱりそうなんだ。一度殺しかけた士郎に助けられたクセに、恩も感じずにお城に戻るワケね。
findings.governingReading: Rin provocatively says Illya is returning to her castle without gratitude after being saved by Shirou, whom she once nearly killed.
findings.explanation: Rin's reminder that Illya once nearly killed Shirou disappears.

findings.highlight: "You're saying it right now. You don't want to go to Emiya's house because you don't want to rely on him, right? You'd feel better back at your own castle."
findings.evidenceJa: 「言ってるじゃない。衛宮くんの家に行かないのは、衛宮くんが頼りにならないからでしょ？　だから安心できる自分の城に戻るって言ってるんじゃない」
findings.governingReading: Rin falsely paraphrases Illya as refusing the house because Emiya himself is not dependable, preferring her secure castle.
findings.explanation: Shirou being unreliable becomes Illya not wanting to rely on him.
